scenario: My flight from Singapore to Tokyo was delayed 7 hours because of a typhoon. Can I claim?
notes: Delay of 6 continuous hours or more on scheduled public transport.

scenario: My flight from Seoul to Busan was delayed 4 hours. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Below the 6-hour threshold.

scenario: My flight was delayed. Can I claim?
notes: Length of the delay not stated.

scenario: The coach that my tour company privately arranged for our group in Vietnam left 8 hours late, so I reached Hoi An 8 hours behind schedule. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Transportation privately arranged for tours is excluded from scheduled public transport.

scenario: I booked a taxi to take me from Osaka to Kyoto. It broke down and I arrived 7 hours late. Is that covered under travel delay?
notes: Taxis are excluded from scheduled public transport.

scenario: My pre-booked overnight train from Bangkok to Chiang Mai, run by the national railway, arrived 9 hours late because of flooding on the track. Can I claim?
notes: Pre-booked train run by a licensed operator on a schedule; delay over 6 hours.

scenario: I reached the airport after check-in had closed and missed my flight to Perth. The next flight was 10 hours later. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Must have checked in on time for the original scheduled transport.

scenario: My flight from Singapore to London was overbooked and the airline moved me to a flight 12 hours later. Can I claim?
notes: Forced to travel at another time because of overbooking; over 6 hours.

scenario: My friend, who booked the trip with me, got into an argument on the plane and it returned to the gate. We left 8 hours late. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Delay caused by a travel companion is not covered.

scenario: A typhoon heading to Manila was all over the news when I bought my policy the next day. My flight there was then delayed 10 hours by that typhoon. Can I claim?
notes: Event publicised before the policy was bought.

scenario: My flight to Sydney was diverted to Melbourne because of a medical emergency on board, and I reached Sydney 8 hours late. Can I claim?
notes: Airplane diversion of 6 continuous hours or more.

scenario: My flight to Bali was diverted to Lombok and I reached Bali 3 hours late. Can I claim trip diversion?
notes: Below 6 hours.

scenario: My first flight arrived late in Doha so I missed my connection to Paris. The next available flight was 11 hours later. Can I claim?
notes: Missed connection, no alternative within 6 hours.

scenario: I missed my connecting flight in Hong Kong because my first flight landed late, but the airline put me on another flight 2 hours later. Can I claim missed connection?
notes: An alternative was available within 6 hours.

scenario: My flight into Dubai landed late and I missed my connecting flight to Rome. Can I claim for the missed connection?
notes: Wait for the next alternative not stated.

scenario: I landed in Osaka but my checked-in suitcase only arrived 9 hours later. Can I claim?
notes: Baggage delayed 6 hours or more after arrival.

scenario: My checked bag arrived at the hotel 3 hours after I landed in Taipei. Is that covered?
notes: Below 6 hours.

scenario: The airline misplaced my suitcase when I landed in Paris but found it later. Can I claim baggage delay?
notes: Length of the baggage delay not stated.

scenario: My backpack with about S$200 of clothes was stolen at a train station in Milan. I reported it to the police the same day. Can I claim?
notes: Theft of personal belongings during the trip, reported within 24 hours.

scenario: My hand-carried laptop, bought a month ago for S$1,800, was stolen from my table at a cafe in London. I reported it to the police within an hour. Will I get the full amount back?
notes: Laptop/tablet sub-limit is S$1,000 on every plan.

scenario: I packed my mobile phone in my checked-in suitcase and it was stolen before the bag reached the carousel. Can I claim?
notes: Phones must be carried and not checked in.

scenario: Someone stole my toiletry bag with perfume and skincare products from my hotel room. I reported it to the police. Can I claim?
notes: Perishables and consumables are excluded.

scenario: My suitcase was stolen at a bus station in Spain. It had S$250 of clothes and S$80 of toiletries. I reported it to the police the same day. Can I claim for everything?
notes: Clothes covered; toiletries excluded as consumables.

scenario: My suitcase came off the plane with scratches and a dent, but it still works fine. Can I claim for the damage?
notes: Scratches and dents that do not affect function count as wear and tear.

scenario: The airline broke my guitar during my flight to Melbourne. Can I claim for it?
notes: Musical instruments are excluded.

scenario: Halfway through my trip I noticed my sunglasses were gone. I have no idea where or how I lost them. Can I claim?
notes: Unexplained loss or mysterious disappearance is excluded.

scenario: I borrowed my friend's camera for the trip and it was stolen in Rome. I reported it to the police the same day. Can I claim for it?
notes: Items that do not belong to you are excluded.

scenario: Customs officers at the airport in Bangkok confiscated my drone. Can I claim for it?
notes: Confiscation by customs is a general exclusion.

scenario: I lost my passport while sightseeing in Rome and had to pay for a replacement at the embassy. Can I claim the cost?
notes: Cost to replace a passport while overseas.

scenario: S$800 in cash was stolen from the wallet in my pocket in Barcelona. I reported it to the police that day. Will I get all S$800 back?
notes: Theft of money sub-limit is S$300 on every plan.

scenario: I left S$500 in cash in my rental car while I went into a museum, and it was stolen. Can I claim?
notes: Money left in an unattended vehicle is not covered.

scenario: I lost my passport in Paris and had to stay 3 extra hotel nights while waiting for a new one. Can I claim the hotel nights?
notes: Only the replacement cost is paid; no other expenses.

scenario: My credit card was skimmed in Bangkok and someone made S$250 of charges. I reported it to my bank and the police the same day. Can I claim?
notes: Unauthorised charges overseas, reported within 24 hours.

scenario: The friend I was travelling with used my credit card without asking me while we were in Seoul. Can I claim the charges?
notes: Charges by a travel companion are excluded.

scenario: I slipped on a wet floor at my hotel in Seoul and broke my wrist. I was treated at a hospital there. Can I claim the medical bills?
notes: Unexpected injury overseas needing medically necessary treatment.

scenario: I have had asthma for years. I had a bad attack in Tokyo and needed hospital treatment. I did not buy the pre-existing conditions add-on. Can I claim?
notes: Known condition before the trip; optional cover not bought.

scenario: A filling in my tooth fell out while I was in Sydney and I paid a dentist to replace it. Can I claim?
notes: Dental expenses for fillings are excluded.

scenario: I was drunk after a night out in Bangkok, fell down some stairs and broke my arm. Can I claim my hospital bill?
notes: Injury while under the influence of alcohol.

scenario: I got altitude sickness trekking at 4,200 metres in Nepal and needed treatment. Can I claim?
notes: Hiking or trekking above 3,000 m is excluded.

scenario: I got food poisoning in Bali and saw a doctor at a clinic there. Can I claim the bill?
notes: Unexpected illness overseas needing treatment.

scenario: I am pregnant and had complications on holiday in Taiwan that needed hospital care. Is it covered?
notes: Pregnancy and related complications are excluded.

scenario: I went diving in Thailand with a guy on the beach who isn't a licensed operator and injured my ear. Can I claim medical costs?
notes: Sport not managed by a licensed commercial operator.

scenario: My heart condition flared up while I was in Japan and I needed treatment. Can I claim?
notes: Not stated whether the condition was pre-existing or whether the optional cover was bought.

scenario: I flew to Seoul to get a knee operation because it is cheaper there. Can I claim the hospital bill?
notes: Travelling to seek medical treatment is excluded; treatment was also pre-arranged.

scenario: I sprained my ankle in Kuala Lumpur and my cousin, who is a doctor there, treated me and charged me. Can I claim?
notes: Treatment from an interested party (family member) is excluded.

scenario: I hurt my back lifting my bag in Hong Kong and saw a doctor in Singapore the morning after I got home. Can I claim?
notes: Treatment in Singapore within 48 hours of return for an overseas injury.

scenario: I twisted my knee in Japan but didn't see anyone there. I saw a doctor in Singapore 5 days after I got back. Can I claim?
notes: Not treated overseas and not within 48 hours of return.

scenario: I was in hospital in Bangkok for 3 days with dengue and my mother flew over to be with me. Can I claim her flight?
notes: Confinement must be at least 5 continuous days.

scenario: I was travelling alone and was in hospital in Bangkok for 7 days. The doctor said I could not fly home, so my mother flew over. Can I claim her economy flight and hotel?
notes: All conditions met.

scenario: I was hospitalised in Tokyo for 6 days and could not fly home. My husband was already travelling with me, and my sister flew in too. Can I claim her flight?
notes: An adult family member was already with the insured.

scenario: I accidentally knocked over an expensive vase in a shop in Kyoto and the owner took me to court. I was ordered to pay damages. Is that covered?
notes: Legal liability for accidental damage to another person's property.

scenario: I rented a bicycle in Amsterdam and accidentally hit a pedestrian, who is now suing me. Will my policy cover it?
notes: Liability from using bicycles is excluded.

scenario: I accidentally injured my brother while we were on holiday in Bali and he is claiming damages from me. Is my liability covered?
notes: The other person must not be an interested party (family member).

scenario: I was hit by a car while on holiday in Vietnam and lost all sight in one eye a month later. Can I claim personal accident?
notes: Loss of sight in one eye within 90 days of an accident (50% of the limit is still a covered claim).

scenario: Two weeks before my trip to Japan, my mother was hospitalised with a life-threatening illness, so I cancelled. I bought the policy two months ago. Can I claim my lost deposits?
notes: Listed event within 30 days of departure; policy bought well before.

scenario: I bought my policy 2 days before my flight, then fell seriously ill and a doctor said I could not travel. Can I claim trip cancellation?
notes: Policy bought less than 72 hours before departure.

scenario: I was diagnosed with a new illness 10 days before departure and my doctor said I was unfit to travel, so I cancelled. I bought the policy a month earlier. Is it covered?
notes: A new condition that starts 30 or fewer days before departure is not pre-existing for cancellation.

scenario: Work got too busy so I cancelled my holiday to Korea. Can I claim my lost hotel deposit?
notes: Not a listed event.

scenario: A major earthquake hit Taiwan two weeks before my trip there and I could not go. I bought the policy a month before. Can I claim my cancellation costs?
notes: Natural disaster is a serious public event at the destination.

scenario: The forecast showed light rain for my whole week in Phuket, so I cancelled the trip. Can I claim?
notes: Ordinary weather is not a natural disaster or other serious public event.

scenario: My airline cancelled my flight to Melbourne because of a crew shortage, so I cancelled the whole trip. Can I claim?
notes: Cancellations due to the airline's own fault are excluded.

scenario: My father died a week before our trip, so I cancelled. The airline gave me an S$800 voucher for my S$2,000 ticket. Can I claim the full S$2,000?
notes: Refunds in any form, including vouchers, are deducted.

scenario: The concert I was flying to Bangkok for got cancelled, so I cancelled my trip. My travel insurance covers that, right?
notes: False assumption: event cancellation is not a listed event.

scenario: The WHO declared a pandemic, so I cancelled my trip to Europe. Can I claim my cancellation costs?
notes: Declared epidemic or pandemic is a general exclusion.

scenario: My friend, who was booked on the same trip, died suddenly a week before we were due to leave, so I cancelled. Can I claim?
notes: Death of a travel companion is a listed event.

scenario: I was summoned as a witness in court during my travel dates, so I postponed my trip to Japan by two months and paid rebooking fees. Can I claim them?
notes: Court witness is a listed event; rebooking within 180 days.

scenario: My onward flight was cancelled because of bad weather, so I postponed the whole trip. Can I claim the rebooking fees under trip postponement?
notes: Weather flight cancellation is not a postponement event.

scenario: My father died while I was on holiday in London, so I flew home early and paid for a new economy ticket. Can I claim?
notes: Death of a family member; extra return cost.

scenario: I had to cut my trip short when my mother was hospitalised. Can I claim the taxi fare to the airport?
notes: Public transport costs such as taxis are excluded under Trip cut short.

scenario: My sister died while I was in New York, so I flew home early in business class. Can I claim the whole business-class fare?
notes: Return cost covered at economy; the upgrade is excluded.

scenario: My flight from Kathmandu was cancelled because the airport closed, so I paid for an extra hotel night and a new economy ticket. Can I claim?
notes: Airport closure; additional transport and accommodation.

scenario: There had been riots in the city for weeks before I flew there. Then rioters blocked the airport and I had to pay for extra hotel nights. Can I claim?
notes: Riot present before the visit; only cancellation and postponement remain claimable.

scenario: The tour company I prepaid for my Europe tour went bankrupt and stopped operating before I left. I bought my policy a month earlier. Can I claim?
notes: Insolvency of a tour operator before departure.

scenario: I fell ill while visiting Iran and needed hospital treatment. Can I claim?
notes: Iran is a specified country with no cover.

scenario: I forgot to buy insurance, so I bought it at the airport after landing in Bangkok. Then my bag was stolen. Can I claim?
notes: Policy bought after departing Singapore does not start.

scenario: My flight home to Singapore was delayed 8 hours and I had to pay for an extra night for my dog at the kennel. Can I claim?
notes: Not stated whether the optional Pet care cover was bought.

scenario: The airline damaged my golf clubs on my trip to Thailand. Can I claim?
notes: Sports equipment is excluded from baggage cover; depends on whether the optional sports equipment cover was bought.

scenario: I twisted my ankle trekking at 2,800 metres in Nepal and was treated at a clinic. Can I claim?
notes: Below the 3,000 m trekking exclusion.

scenario: I have had asthma for years and bought the optional pre-existing conditions cover, which shows on my insurance summary. I had an attack in Tokyo and needed hospital treatment. Can I claim?
notes: Optional cover bought and shown in the summary.

scenario: I went diving in Bali with a licensed dive company, followed all their safety rules, and hurt my ear. Can I claim my treatment?
notes: Recreational sport with a licensed operator, rules followed.

scenario: My pre-booked ferry from Hong Kong to Macau, run by a licensed ferry company, left 7 hours late because of rough seas. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Pre-booked scheduled ferry counts as scheduled public transport.

scenario: Two days before departure, my flight to Iceland was cancelled because of a volcanic ash airspace closure, so I cancelled the whole trip. I bought the policy a month earlier. Can I claim?
notes: Onward flight cancelled due to airspace closure is a cancellation event.

scenario: Ten days before my trip, the Singapore government warned against non-essential travel to my destination, so I cancelled. I bought the policy a month earlier. Can I claim?
notes: Government travel warning is a serious public event.

scenario: My flat in Singapore was badly damaged by fire while I was in Seoul, so I flew home early on a new economy ticket. Can I claim?
notes: Home seriously damaged by fire is a listed event.

scenario: When I flew home to Singapore my checked bag arrived 8 hours after I landed. Can I claim baggage delay?
notes: Final return to Singapore is included; only the first 6 hours are paid, but it is covered.

scenario: Three weeks before my trip, my sister had a life-threatening stroke confirmed by her doctor, so I postponed the trip by a month and paid rebooking fees. Can I claim them?
notes: Sister is a family member; life-threatening illness is a postponement event.

scenario: My bag was stolen in Lisbon. It had S$200 of clothes and a transport card with S$50 loaded on it. I reported it to the police that day. Can I claim both?
notes: Clothes covered; transport cards and their value are excluded.

scenario: My mother was hospitalised, so I flew home early from Paris. I paid for a new economy ticket and a taxi to the airport. Can I claim both?
notes: New ticket covered; taxi excluded under Trip cut short.

scenario: My flight out of Tokyo was cancelled by a typhoon, so I paid for an extra hotel night, plus S$60 of minibar and room service. Can I claim all of it?
notes: Extra accommodation covered; minibar and food are incidental charges.

scenario: My camera and a lens I borrowed from a friend were stolen from my hotel room in Hanoi. I reported it to the police that day. Can I claim for both?
notes: Own camera covered; borrowed lens does not belong to the insured.

scenario: I lost my passport in Seoul. I paid for the replacement and a taxi to the embassy. Can I claim both?
notes: Replacement cost covered; no other expenses are paid.

scenario: I fell in Sydney and broke a natural tooth and a crown. The dentist fixed both. Can I claim everything?
notes: Accidental dental injury covered; crowns are excluded.

scenario: My grandmother fell ill a week before my trip, so I cancelled. Can I claim?
notes: Not stated whether the illness was life-threatening (confirmed by a doctor).

scenario: I injured my knee trekking in Nepal and needed treatment. Can I claim?
notes: Altitude not stated; the 3,000 m exclusion may apply.

scenario: I was in hospital in Bangkok for 6 days and my mum flew over. Can I claim her flight?
notes: Not stated whether the doctor said the insured could not return, or whether another adult family member was there.

scenario: My brother was in an accident back home, so I cut my trip short. Can I claim?
notes: Severity not stated; the event must be life-threatening (or death).

scenario: My transport to the next city was 9 hours late. Can I claim travel delay?
notes: Type of transport not stated; taxis and private tour transport are excluded.
